metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: Since they loved Kung Fu Panda and Shrek, this DreamWorks classic delivers a thrilling adventure with heartwarming humor and spectacular animation.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: Perfect for fans of Despicable Me, this film features a hilarious supervillain who accidentally defeats his nemesis and has to find a new purpose.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: A thrilling and funny superhero adventure from Pixar that captures the same family warmth and high energy as Inside Out and Toy Story.

metas.name: WALL-E
metas.description: An incredibly charming, visually stunning, and sweet Pixar story about a lonely little robot that will delight fans of Finding Nemo and Toy Story.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A beautiful, funny, and deeply touching adventure film that matches the creative genius and humor of Inside Out 2 and Monsters, Inc.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: An imaginative and fast-paced video game adventure that offers the same playful comedy and heartwarming character growth as Sonic the Hedgehog.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: A wonderful mix of action, comedy, and heart featuring a lovable inflatable robot, perfect for kids who enjoyed Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A delightful, laugh-out-loud family comedy about a polite bear in London that captures the same whimsical British charm as Wallace & Gromit.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: A critically acclaimed, incredibly heartwarming, and hilarious sequel that is universally loved by children and parents alike.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep Movie
metas.description: From Aardman, the creators of Chicken Run, this dialogue-free slapstick comedy is packed with brilliant visual jokes that will make kids of all ages laugh.

metas.name: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
metas.description: An Oscar-winning claymation comedy that is just as charming, witty, and fun as Wallace & Gromit: Vengeance Most Fowl.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A wildly energetic and hilarious modern family comedy from the creative minds behind Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: An incredibly fast-paced, colorful, and silly comedy about food raining from the sky, appealing to fans of Despicable Me and Migration.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: From the studio that brought you Despicable Me, this fun-filled adventure showing what pets do when their owners leave will thoroughly entertain kids.

metas.name: Klaus
metas.description: A beautifully animated, hilarious, and heartwarming origin story of Santa Claus, ideal for those who enjoyed The Grinch.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: A gorgeous Studio Ghibli film based on the classic story of 'The Borrowers', perfect for kids who loved both the Ghibli films and the 1997 live-action movie.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A heartwarming, colorful, and sunny Pixar adventure set in Italy about friendship and secret sea monsters, perfect for fans of Finding Nemo.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: A fun and emotional fantasy-adventure about two elf brothers, perfect for those who enjoyed the magical worlds of Shrek and Tangled.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: A fantastic and funny continuation of Po's journey that fans of the first two Kung Fu Panda films are sure to love.

metas.name: Monsters University
metas.description: Since they enjoyed Monsters, Inc., they will love seeing the hilarious back-story of how Mike and Sulley became best friends in college.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon 2
metas.description: An exceptional sequel that expands the world with even more spectacular dragon flights, comedy, and deep family emotions.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A hilarious, action-packed prehistoric family adventure that matches the physical comedy and scale of Ice Age.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A magical, sweet-natured adventure about a girl helping a lovable Yeti get back to his family on Mount Everest.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: Since they have already watched Frozen II, they will love experiencing the original, heartwarming story of sisterhood and hit musical numbers.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: A fun Disney adventure about a heroic TV dog who thinks his powers are real, matching the excitement and comedy of Sonic the Hedgehog.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: A fast-paced, incredibly silly animated comedy about a hotel for monsters that has the same high-energy vibe as Despicable Me.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: For kids who loved the sidekicks in Despicable Me, this film focuses entirely on the hilarious, chaotic, and yellow helpers.

metas.name: Despicable Me 3
metas.description: A great continuation of the Despicable Me franchise that introduces Gru's cheerful twin brother, Dru.

metas.name: Leo
metas.description: A highly rated, funny, and incredibly sweet animated musical about a class lizard offering life advice to school kids.

metas.name: Nimona
metas.description: An action-packed, funny, and beautifully animated fantasy about a shapeshifting girl, perfect for fans of Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Flushed Away
metas.description: Co-produced by DreamWorks and Aardman, this hilarious underground adventure captures the identical comedy style of Chicken Run.

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie
metas.description: A charming, sweet, and beautifully crafted adventure that captures the classic, gentle humor of Snoopy and Charlie Brown.

metas.name: A Bug's Life
metas.description: A Pixar classic about a brave ant seeking warriors to save his colony, offering the same scale of adventure as Toy Story and Finding Nemo.

metas.name: Meet the Robinsons
metas.description: A highly inventive, funny, and touching time-travel adventure featuring a wonderfully quirky family.

metas.name: The Iron Giant
metas.description: A timeless, beautiful, and touching animated classic about friendship, perfect for kids who love heartwarming stories.

metas.name: Arthur Christmas
metas.description: A clever, highly original, and hilarious Christmas movie made in collaboration with Aardman that will delight fans of holiday comedies.

metas.name: Babe
metas.description: A beloved live-action family comedy about a polite little pig who learns to herd sheep, carrying the same sweet charm as Matilda.

metas.name: Night at the Museum
metas.description: A magical, high-energy live-action adventure comedy about museum exhibits coming to life, great for fans of Sonic the Hedgehog.

metas.name: Mary and the Witch's Flower
metas.description: Created by former Ghibli animators, this gorgeous magical-fantasy adventure is highly recommended for fans of Kiki's Delivery Service.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: An iconic, upbeat, and very funny DreamWorks adventure about zoo animals getting stranded in the wild, matching the humor of Ice Age.
